chinaProtection: 国家一级保护（野生种群）
distributionZh: 野生种群仅存于浙江天目山狭谷地带，全国各地的银杏多为人工栽培后代。
distributionEn: Wild populations survive only in the Tianmu Mountains of Zhejiang; ginkgo trees elsewhere in China are cultivated descendants.
habitatZh: 山谷阔叶林缘、湿润山坡
habitatEn: Valley forest margins and moist slopes
descriptionZh: 被称为“活化石”的孑遗植物，距今约2.7亿年前就已出现。叶片扇形，秋日满树金黄。野生种群数量极为稀少，是天目山保护区重点守护的对象。
descriptionEn: A living fossil that appeared some 270 million years ago. Its fan-shaped leaves turn brilliant gold in autumn. Truly wild populations are extremely rare and are closely guarded in the Tianmu Mountain reserve.
threatZh: 野生种群退化、幼苗更新困难
threatEn: Population ageing and poor seedling regeneration

distributionZh: 野生植株仅见于湖北利川谋道溪一带的河谷，已引种至世界各地。
distributionEn: Native stands are confined to the Modaoxi valley in Lichuan, Hubei; now planted worldwide.
habitatEn: Moist valley bottoms and streamside foothills
descriptionZh: 曾被认为早已灭绝，1941年在湖北利川重新发现，轰动国际植物学界。落叶乔木，冬季叶与小枝一同脱落，是杉科植物中的“孑遗明星”。
descriptionEn: Believed extinct until its rediscovery in Lichuan, Hubei in 1941, which stunned botanists worldwide. This deciduous conifer sheds its needles along whole branchlets in winter.
threatZh: 原生母树老化、生境萎缩
threatEn: Ageing mother trees and shrinking habitat

distributionZh: 零散分布于西南山地海拔1500–2200米的常绿落叶阔叶混交林中。
distributionEn: Scattered in mixed evergreen-deciduous forests at 1500–2200 m in the mountains of south-west China.
habitatEn: Cool moist valleys and shaded broad-leaved slopes
descriptionZh: 第四纪冰川幸存者，花序基部两枚白色苞片形似白鸽展翅，盛开时满树如群鸽栖枝，故有“鸽子树”之称。
descriptionEn: A survivor of the Ice Age whose two white bracts resemble a dove in flight; a tree in full bloom looks as if doves are resting on every branch.
threatZh: 种子萌发率低、林下更新不足
threatEn: Low germination rate and poor understory regeneration

distributionZh: 长江流域以南各省山地，呈岛状零星分布。
distributionEn: Patchily distributed across mountains south of the Yangtze valley.
descriptionZh: 叶形如马褂，俗称“马褂木”。花杯状淡绿，是与北美鹅掌楸隔洋相望的姊妹种，见证东亚—北美植物区系的古老联系。
descriptionEn: Its leaves look like a traditional Chinese jacket, hence the name 'jacket tree'. The sister species lives in North America, evidence of an ancient link between the two floras.
threatZh: 过度采伐、生境片段化
threatEn: Over-logging and habitat fragmentation

distributionZh: 仅存于浙江庆元百山祖海拔1700米左右的针阔混交林中。
distributionEn: Known only from about 1700 m on Baishanzu, Qingyuan, Zhejiang.
habitatEn: Gentle summit slopes in mixed forest
descriptionZh: 全世界野生植株一度仅存3株，被称为“植物界大熊猫”。经多年保育，如今已成功繁育出数百株幼苗。
descriptionEn: Once reduced to just three wild trees, it is nicknamed the 'panda of the plant world'. Years of conservation have produced hundreds of seedlings.
threatZh: 种群极度微小、气候变暖
threatEn: Tiny population size and climate warming

distributionZh: 原树仅存一株于浙江普陀山佛顶山，现已大量人工繁育回归。
distributionEn: The single original tree stands on Putuo Mountain, Zhejiang; thousands of offspring have since been propagated.
descriptionZh: 一度全世界仅剩一株的“地球独子”，经人工授粉与组培技术获救，如今子代已回归野外，成为植物拯救的经典案例。
descriptionEn: Once the loneliest tree on Earth with a single survivor, it was rescued by hand pollination and tissue culture, and its progeny have been returned to the wild.
threatZh: 自花授粉结实率低、风暴威胁
threatEn: Poor self-pollination success and typhoon damage

distributionZh: 零星生长于南岭、大娄山等山地陡崖之上。
distributionEn: Scattered on cliffs of the Nanling and Dalou mountains.
habitatZh: 山脊岩壁、陡坡针阔混交林
habitatEn: Ridge cliffs and steep mixed forests
descriptionZh: 1950年代发现的松科孑遗植物，为中国特有。叶背两条银白色气孔带在阳光下银光闪烁，因此得名。
descriptionEn: A relict conifer endemic to China, described in the 1950s. The two silvery stomatal bands beneath its needles glitter in sunlight.
threatZh: 分布区狭小、种群隔离
threatEn: Very restricted range and isolated subpopulations

distributionZh: 仅见于云南马关、西畴等地的季风常绿阔叶林中。
distributionEn: Confined to monsoon evergreen broad-leaved forest in southeastern Yunnan.
descriptionZh: 树高达40米的巨型木兰，全世界野生不足百株。花大如盘，树冠如华盖，被称为植物界的“大熊猫”之一。
descriptionEn: A magnolia giant reaching 40 m with fewer than a hundred trees left in the wild. Its crown spreads like a ceremonial canopy over the rainforest.
threatZh: 栖息地丧失、种子天然更新差
threatEn: Habitat loss and weak natural regeneration

distributionZh: 广泛但零散分布于长江以南山地林中。
distributionEn: Widespread but scattered in mountains south of the Yangtze.
habitatEn: Shaded moist valleys and streamside forest edges
descriptionZh: 红色假种皮如玛瑙珠点缀枝头。树皮含紫杉醇，曾因抗癌药原料需求遭到大规模盗剥，如今受到严格保护。
descriptionEn: Its scarlet arils stud the branches like beads of cornelian. Bark yields the cancer drug paclitaxel, which once triggered rampant illegal stripping.
threatZh: 历史上的盗伐盗剥、生长缓慢
threatEn: Historic poaching and slow growth

distributionZh: 华南、西南山地沟谷雨林中。
distributionEn: Rainforest gullies of southern and south-western China.
habitatEn: Hot wet ravines and shaded streamsides
descriptionZh: 现存唯一的树状蕨类之一，与恐龙同时代。茎干直立可达数米，顶端伞状羽叶，仿佛把侏罗纪森林留在今天。
descriptionEn: One of the few tree ferns alive, contemporary with the dinosaurs. Its upright trunk and umbrella of fronds carry the Jurassic forest into the present.
threatZh: 生境破坏、人为采挖
threatEn: Habitat destruction and collection

distributionZh: 华南的池塘、沼泽与河滩草甸。
distributionEn: Ponds, marshes and river shoals of southern China.
descriptionZh: 栽培稻的野生祖先，携带抗病、耐涝等宝贵基因，是水稻育种的天然基因库。大量原产地已因土地开发而消失。
descriptionEn: The wild ancestor of cultivated rice, carrying genes for disease and flood tolerance — a living seed bank for breeders. Many sites have been lost to land reclamation.
threatZh: 湿地围垦、除草剂漂移
threatEn: Wetland conversion and herbicide drift

chinaProtection: 国家一级保护（野生种群）
distributionZh: 长白山地阔叶红松林下，野生个体已极罕见。
distributionEn: Beneath broad-leaved Korean pine forests in the Changbai Mountains; wild plants are now extremely rare.
descriptionZh: 千年药草之王。数百年高强度采挖使野生人参濒临枯竭，如今市场上流通的多为人工栽培品。
descriptionEn: The king of medicinal herbs. Centuries of harvesting have nearly exhausted wild roots; commercial ginseng today is almost entirely cultivated.
threatZh: 过度采挖、森林退化
threatEn: Over-collection and forest degradation

distributionZh: 广西防城港一带的喀斯特山谷为世界分布中心。
distributionEn: Karst valleys around Fangchenggang, Guangxi, form the world centre of diversity.
descriptionZh: 山茶家族中罕见的金黄色花系，被誉为“茶族皇后”。上世纪的发现曾引起国际园艺界轰动。
descriptionEn: A rare golden-flowered camellia hailed as the 'queen of the tea family'. Its discovery caused a sensation in horticultural circles worldwide.
threatZh: 盗挖盗采、喀斯特生境破坏
threatEn: Poaching and karst habitat damage

distributionZh: 四川峨眉山及邻近山地海拔1000–1500米林中。
distributionEn: Forests at 1000–1500 m on Mount Emei and adjacent ranges.
descriptionZh: 早春开满淡黄花朵、香气清远的木兰科小乔木。因林下开荒与采伐，原生大树所剩无几。
descriptionEn: A small magnolia that in early spring bears pale fragrant blossoms. Few large trees remain after decades of clearing and felling.
threatZh: 低海拔林地开发
threatEn: Development of lowland forest

distributionZh: 云南西部石灰岩山地岩缝与灌丛中。
distributionEn: Rock crevices and thickets on limestone in western Yunnan.
habitatEn: Ledge soil pockets in open woodland
descriptionZh: 杏黄色口袋状唇瓣如小巧的拖鞋，是兜兰中的“金童”。园艺盗采曾使多个产地一夜被采空。
descriptionEn: Its apricot pouch-like lip resembles a tiny slipper. Poaching for the orchid trade once stripped whole sites overnight.
threatZh: 盗采、生境退化
threatEn: Illegal collection and habitat degradation

distributionZh: 华南零星残存于池塘边与河岸湿地。
distributionEn: Remnant stands survive beside ponds and rivers in southern China.
descriptionZh: 与水杉同一家族的孑遗树种，树干基部膨大具膝状呼吸根，是湿地生态的活纪念碑。多数残存林已难以自然更新。
descriptionEn: A relict cousin of the dawn redwood with a buttressed trunk and knuckle-like pneumatophores — a living monument of wetland ecosystems. Most remaining stands show little natural regeneration.
threatZh: 湿地排水垦殖、种群老化
threatEn: Wetland drainage and an ageing population

distributionZh: 长江中下游山地，天目山保存有成片野生林。
distributionEn: Mountains of the middle-lower Yangtze; wild groves persist on Tianmu Mountain.
descriptionZh: 秋叶纯黄的落叶松近亲，中国特有单种属。短枝上簇生的柔软针叶如枚枚铜钱，故名金钱松。
descriptionEn: A Chinese endemic and the only species of its genus, turning pure gold in autumn. Soft needles cluster on short shoots like strings of coins.
threatZh: 历史采伐、分布零散
threatEn: Historical logging and fragmented range

distributionZh: 云南高黎贡山海拔2800米上下的苔藓矮林中。
distributionEn: Mossy dwarf forests around 2800 m on the Gaoligong Mountains, Yunnan.
descriptionZh: 世界杜鹃家族的巨人，树高可达25米，花序如血色绣球。原生大树仅存数百株，是高黎贡山的传奇物种。
descriptionEn: The giant of the rhododendron clan, reaching 25 m with crimson flower heads. Only a few hundred old trees survive on the Gaoligong slopes.
threatZh: 数量稀少、高山生境脆弱
threatEn: Tiny population and fragile cloud-forest habitat

distributionZh: 四川攀枝花金沙江干热河谷坡地。
distributionEn: Dry-hot Jinsha River valley slopes around Panzhihua, Sichuan.
descriptionZh: 在年蒸发量远超降雨量的干热河谷中顽强生存的苏铁群落，树龄可达数百年，被誉为“植物活化石群”。
descriptionEn: A cycad community thriving where evaporation far exceeds rainfall, with individuals centuries old — a grove of living fossils in the dry valley.
threatZh: 盗挖、生境干旱化加剧
threatEn: Poaching and deepening aridity

distributionZh: 长江以南山地常绿阔叶林中星散分布。
distributionEn: Sparsely scattered in evergreen forests across southern China.
descriptionZh: 以德国医生伯乐（Bretschneider）命名的单型科树种。粉色总状花序高悬枝顶，落叶如桃花纷飞，故别名“钟萼木”。
descriptionEn: Named after the physician Bretschneider, this single-family tree hoists pink flower spikes above the canopy; its fallen petals recall peach blossom.
threatZh: 结实率低、林下更新少
threatEn: Poor fruit set and little recruitment

distributionZh: 长江以南广泛生长，是南方城市最常见的古树之一。
distributionEn: Common throughout southern China; the most familiar heritage tree of southern towns.
descriptionZh: 树冠浓密如盖、寿命可达千年的常绿大树。全株含樟脑香气，木材防虫，是江南乡土记忆的一部分。
descriptionEn: A dense evergreen that can live a thousand years. Its camphor-scented, insect-resistant timber is woven into the memory of southern Chinese villages.

distributionZh: 1935年作为观赏植物引入，现已在华东、华中大面积扩散，铁路沿线、撂荒地尤多。
distributionEn: Introduced as an ornamental in 1935, now rampant across eastern and central China, especially along railways and fallow land.
habitatZh: 荒地、路边、河滩、农田边缘
habitatEn: Wasteland, roadsides, river shoals and field margins
descriptionZh: 一株可产2万余枚带冠毛的种子，随风远播；根状茎还能分泌化感物质抑制其他植物，所到之处常形成单优势群落，被称为“生态杀手”。
descriptionEn: One plant releases over 20,000 plumed seeds on the wind, while its rhizomes exude allelopathic chemicals, forming near-monocultures that have earned it the name 'ecological killer'.

distributionZh: 1901年作为花卉引入，现已蔓延至华南、西南大部分水域。
distributionEn: Brought in as an ornamental in 1901, now spread across most warm waterways of the south.
descriptionZh: 看似紫色花海，实为“水上灾星”：疯长时覆盖水面，耗尽溶解氧、堵塞航道。打捞与生物防治（象甲）是主要治理手段。
descriptionEn: A violet bloom that belies a waterborne scourge: explosive mats smother the surface, starve the water of oxygen and block navigation. Control relies on harvesting and weevil biocontrol.

distributionZh: 约1940年代经中缅边境传入，现占据西南山地大片坡地。
distributionEn: Entered from Myanmar in the 1940s and now blankets vast slopes of the south-west.
habitatEn: Hillsides, abandoned fields, forest edges and roadsides
descriptionZh: 每平方米可产数十万粒瘦果，化感物质令周边植物枯萎。侵占草场、毒害牲畜，云南部分地区曾以飞机防治遏制其蔓延。
descriptionEn: Its allelopathic litter chokes native plants while a single square metre sheds hundreds of thousands of seeds, degrading pasture and poisoning livestock.

distributionZh: 1980年代入侵珠三角，如今蔓延于华南低地。
distributionEn: Invaded the Pearl River Delta in the 1980s and now spreads across the southern lowlands.
habitatEn: Forest edges, orchards and open woodland
descriptionZh: 茎节遇土即生根，一天可爬升数十厘米，层层缠绕覆盖树冠，被缠树木因缺光成片枯死，被称为“植物杀手”。
descriptionEn: Nodes root on contact and stems climb tens of centimetres a day, smothering canopies until whole trees starve for light — the 'plant killer' of southern forests.

distributionZh: 1930年代随货物传入东北，现已扩散至东北、华北、华东。
distributionEn: Arrived with cargo in the 1930s and has spread across the north, north-east and east.
descriptionZh: 花粉量巨大，是秋季花粉症的主要过敏原，同时严重抑制大豆、玉米等作物，兼具健康与农业双重危害。
descriptionEn: Its prodigious pollen is a leading cause of autumn hay fever, while dense stands suppress soybean and maize — a double blow to health and harvests.

distributionZh: 集中于东北铁路沿线与农田荒地。
distributionEn: Concentrated along railways and farmland in the north-east.
descriptionZh: 株高可达2米以上，花粉致敏性强于豚草，常与豚草混生成灾。其种子随粮食调运长途传播。
descriptionEn: Growing over two metres, its pollen is even more allergenic than common ragweed, and seeds hitch rides in grain shipments.

distributionZh: 上世纪30年代作马饲料引入，现遍及华东、华中、华南、西南。
distributionEn: Introduced as fodder in the 1930s, now ubiquitous from the Yangtze delta to the south-west.
habitatZh: 水陆两生：水面、湿地、旱地均可生长
habitatEn: Amphibious — floating mats or terrestrial stands
descriptionZh: 水陆通吃的全能入侵者，茎段断离即可再生，打捞反而助其扩散。堵塞灌渠、覆盖水面，治理成本极高。
descriptionEn: An all-terrain invader whose broken stems re-root instantly, so careless removal spreads it further. It clogs irrigation channels and smothers open water.

distributionZh: 1979年为保滩护堤引入，现占据从渤海到南海的大片海岸滩涂。
distributionEn: Planted in 1979 to stabilise shores, now dominating tidal flats from Bohai to the South China Sea.
descriptionZh: 促淤能力强，密集植株取代光滩，导致贝类、水鸟栖息地萎缩，红树林难以立足。近年多地开展刈割+淹水治理。
descriptionEn: Its sediment-trapping stands replace open flats, shrinking shellfish beds and bird habitat and squeezing out mangroves; mowing-plus-inundation control is under way in many bays.

distributionZh: 明末作为观赏花卉引入，如今在华南逸为野生，随处可见。
distributionEn: Introduced as an ornamental in late Ming times, now feral throughout the tropical south.
habitatEn: Roadsides, waste slopes and coastal thickets
descriptionZh: 五彩花序艳丽，却是全球百大入侵物种：全株含毒，茎生棘刺，形成密灌丛排挤本土植物，鸟类食果后帮它散种。
descriptionEn: Pretty multicoloured heads hide a top-100 global invader: toxic, spiny thickets displace natives, and fruit-eating birds sow it far and wide.

distributionZh: 1930年代自东南亚蔓延入境，盘踞华南干热河谷与农区。
distributionEn: Spread from South-East Asia in the 1930s, holding dry valleys and farmland in the tropical south.
habitatEn: Open forest, wasteland and rubber plantations
descriptionZh: 种子带冠毛可飘至数十公里外，枝叶含香豆素，牲畜不食且抑制种子发芽，扩散速度如“飞机撒播”，故名。
descriptionEn: Plumed seeds ride the wind for tens of kilometres, and coumarin-laced leaves that cattle refuse also inhibit seed germination — spreading as if sown by plane, hence its Chinese name.

distributionZh: 随进口粮谷混杂传入，见于港口与铁路沿线的农田。
distributionEn: Arrived as a grain contaminant, persisting near ports, railways and farmland.
habitatEn: Cropland, ditch banks and storage yards
descriptionZh: 高粱的近缘杂草，根茎强大、再生极快，是农田恶性害草，也被列为多国检疫对象。
descriptionEn: A tough rhizomatous relative of sorghum that regrows relentlessly, ranking among the world's worst field weeds and a quarantine pest in many countries.

distributionZh: 混入小麦种子传入，散生于北方麦田。
distributionEn: Introduced in wheat seed and scattered through northern grain fields.
descriptionZh: 穗形酷似小麦，籽粒含毒麦碱，人畜误食可致眩晕呕吐，是粮食安全的经典检疫性杂草。
descriptionEn: Its ears mimic wheat while the grains harbour temuline, causing dizziness and vomiting — a classic quarantine weed for food safety.

distributionZh: 2001年前后在河北衡水首次发现，迅速蔓延华北平原。
distributionEn: First recorded in Hengshui, Hebei around 2001, spreading fast on the North China Plain.
habitatEn: Saline wasteland, river flats and roadsides
descriptionZh: 耐盐碱、嗜荒地，一株可结籽数十万粒。根系分泌化感物质，严重抑制棉花、玉米出苗。
descriptionEn: Salt-tolerant and prolific, one plant sheds hundreds of thousands of seeds while root exudates check cotton and maize seedlings.

distributionZh: 随入境货物传入，如今占据西南与华南的扰动地带。
distributionEn: Entered with imported goods and now holds disturbed ground across the tropical south.
descriptionZh: 花粉与绒毛引发人畜皮炎与哮喘，是全球公认的恶性入侵杂草，随交通线快速扩张，需在其结籽前连根清除。
descriptionEn: Pollen and hairs trigger dermatitis and asthma in people and livestock; this notorious global invader races along transport lines and must be uprooted before seeding.

distributionZh: 1860年代在香港被记录，如今广布于南方路旁荒地。
distributionEn: Recorded in Hong Kong in the 1860s and now widespread on southern waste ground.
descriptionZh: 浓烈气味是它的名片，含驱蛔素等挥发油。种子细小极易扩散，常在扰动地抢占裸露生态位。
descriptionEn: Its pungent, ascaridole-rich foliage marks it out; dust-fine seeds colonise any freshly disturbed soil.

distributionZh: 19世纪30年代在澳门见载，现已遍布华南、华东。
distributionEn: Noted in Macau in the 1830s and now common across the south and east.
descriptionZh: 叶腋的一对尖刺令农人却步，与作物争水争肥，还是蔬菜害虫的中间寄主。
descriptionEn: Paired axillary spines make hand-weeding painful; the plants compete with crops and shelter crop pests.

distributionZh: 作蔬菜与观赏植物引入，在南方低地攀援成灾。
distributionEn: Introduced as a vegetable and ornamental, now rampaging through southern lowlands.
descriptionZh: 藤蔓年生长可达数米，块状珠芽落地即生新株，重达数十公斤的藤幕压垮灌木与小树。
descriptionEn: Vines grow metres a year and aerial tubers sprout wherever they fall; curtain-loads of stems crush shrubs and saplings.

distributionZh: 1963年引种用于促淤造陆，现留存于部分北方滩涂。
distributionEn: Planted in 1963 for land-building, persisting on northern tidal flats.
descriptionZh: 曾立下促淤功勋，也被证明挤压贝类与水鸟空间，与互花米草同列滨海入侵治理名单。
descriptionEn: Once praised for trapping sediment, it likewise squeezes out shellfish and birds, joining smooth cordgrass on the coastal control list.

distributionZh: 随进口饲草传入，扎根科尔沁沙地边缘。
distributionEn: Came in with imported fodder and took hold on the Horqin sands.
descriptionZh: 刺苞如小型流星锤，粘附羊毛、划伤牲畜口腔，牧民深恶痛绝；刺苞随车胎与草料长途旅行。
descriptionEn: Burr clusters stick to wool, cut livestock mouths and travel far on tyres and hay — a shepherd's bane.

distributionZh: 作为观赏藤本引入，在华南沿海及岛屿逸生蔓延。
distributionEn: Introduced as an ornamental vine, now feral across the southern coast and islands.
habitatEn: Thickets, forest edges, fences and walls
descriptionZh: 掌状五裂的叶是名字由来。藤蔓绞杀灌木、覆盖树冠，对红树林缘与海岛植被威胁尤大。
descriptionEn: Named for its five-fingered leaves, its twining masses strangle shrubs and shade out mangrove fringes and island vegetation.
